# Framework decision

## Verdict: `WITHHELD`

C9 permits exactly five verdicts: `SELECT_SMITHAY`, `SELECT_LIBMUTTER`, `CONTINUE_DUAL_TRACK`, `REOPEN_FRAMEWORK_SEARCH`, `NATIVE_SHELL_NOT_READY`.

**None of them has been earned, so none is recorded.** `WITHHELD` is not a sixth verdict; it is the absence of one. C9 also says not to force a winner, and choosing between two unmeasured arms would be exactly that — a coin toss wearing a rationale.

The verdict is computed by `v4.verdict`, which requires every mandatory gate of an arm to be `PASS` before that arm can be selected. It is not a field anyone edits.

## Why each arm is disqualified

- smithay: 8 mandatory gate(s) unsatisfied — application-launch=NOT_RUN, gpu-rendering=NOT_AVAILABLE, input-method-v2=NOT_RUN, orca-session=NOT_RUN, pam-unlock=NOT_RUN, screen-sharing-portal-pipewire=NOT_RUN, secure-session-lock=NOT_RUN, two-output-presentation=NOT_AVAILABLE
- libmutter: 8 mandatory gate(s) unsatisfied — application-launch=NOT_IMPLEMENTED, gpu-rendering=NOT_AVAILABLE, input-method-v2=NOT_IMPLEMENTED, orca-session=NOT_IMPLEMENTED, pam-unlock=NOT_IMPLEMENTED, screen-sharing-portal-pipewire=NOT_IMPLEMENTED, secure-session-lock=NOT_IMPLEMENTED, two-output-presentation=NOT_AVAILABLE

## What would change this

Two of the eight mandatory gates — `gpu-rendering` and `two-output-presentation` — are `NOT_AVAILABLE` rather than `NOT_RUN`. They are not waiting on effort; they are waiting on hardware. The probe in `visual-v4/evidence/environment-probe-wsl2-fedora44.txt` records why: no `/dev/dri`, and a software rasteriser.

So V4 cannot conclude on the current host at all, however much of the remaining work is done here. It needs a Linux machine with a real DRM device and two real outputs. On such a host the other six mandatory gates become ordinary engineering.

Until then the operative position is unchanged and is not a verdict about the frameworks: **GNOME remains the supported architecture**, the native shell remains experimental, and no prototype may be described as release-qualified.
